# apply: the desired state for Entra principals, their memberships and database privileges,
# made in one transaction and printed as a diff. Every --prune run is limited to
# azpgaad_test_* principals (--managed-prefix), so recording can't touch other principals.
!sql postgres: drop database if exists azpgaad_test_applydb with (force)
!sql postgres: drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap1
!sql postgres: drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap2
!sql postgres: drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap3
!sql postgres: create database azpgaad_test_applydb
!sql postgres: create role azpgaad_test_ap3 nologin

# Bad specs and flags are usage errors (nothing is read or changed).
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","rolez":[]}]}'
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["SELECT"]}}]}'
apply --spec '{"principals":[]}' --prune sometimes

# --dry-run makes the changes and rolls back, so the server checks them: an unknown object
# ID, a missing role and a missing database fail; nothing is created.
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","type":"user"}]}' --dry-run
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["azpgaad_test_nope"]}]}' --dry-run
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","databases":{"azpgaad_test_nodb":["CONNECT"]}}]}' --dry-run
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_read_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT","TEMP"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap2","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_read_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}}]}' --dry-run
principal list --query "[?starts_with(name, 'azpgaad_test_')].name"

# Apply (with the SQL echoed), then again: nothing left to do.
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_read_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT","TEMP"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap2","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_read_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}}]}' --echo
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_read_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT","TEMP"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap2","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_read_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}}]}'
role list --database azpgaad_test_applydb --query "[?starts_with(roleName, 'azpgaad_test_')].{roleName: roleName, memberOf: memberOf, dbPrivileges: dbPrivileges}"

# A new desired state. ap3 exists but isn't an Entra role: an error unless --on-conflict.
# Without --prune only additions are made.
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_write_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap3","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user"}]}'
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_write_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap3","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user"}]}' --on-conflict relabel
principal list --query "[?starts_with(name, 'azpgaad_test_')].name"

# --prune revoke takes away what's no longer listed: from ap1, and everything from ap2,
# which the spec no longer mentions. It needs --yes (no terminal here) unless --dry-run.
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_write_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap3","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user"}]}' --prune revoke --managed-prefix azpgaad_test_
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_write_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap3","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user"}]}' --prune revoke --managed-prefix azpgaad_test_ --dry-run
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_write_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap3","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user"}]}' --prune revoke --managed-prefix azpgaad_test_ --yes
role list --database azpgaad_test_applydb --query "[?starts_with(roleName, 'azpgaad_test_')].{roleName: roleName, memberOf: memberOf, dbPrivileges: dbPrivileges}"

# --prune drop drops ap2; an empty spec then drops ap1 and ap3 (database privileges are
# revoked first so the drop can succeed).
apply --spec '{"principals":[{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap1","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user","roles":["pg_write_all_data"],"databases":{"azpgaad_test_applydb":["CONNECT"]}},{"name":"azpgaad_test_ap3","oid":"${AZPGAAD_TEST_USER_OID}","type":"user"}]}' --prune drop --managed-prefix azpgaad_test_ --yes
apply --spec '{"principals":[]}' --prune drop --managed-prefix azpgaad_test_ --yes
principal list --query "[?starts_with(name, 'azpgaad_test_')].name"
!sql postgres: drop database if exists azpgaad_test_applydb with (force)
!sql postgres: drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap1
!sql postgres: drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap2
!sql postgres: drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap3
